name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
title: Gallantt Ispat Ltd - 532726 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 volume growth only 1.7% and revenue up 3.95%; EBITDA/ton rose to INR 8,785 from 8,300, but management offers no capacity utilisation data beyond 88% and no peer capacity commentary, with 1.0→1.3 Mt expansion and INR 3,000 cr capex underway.

utilisation.quote: But we have taken lot of initiatives and now we are at 88%.

capex.quote: the current expansion plan which is there with INR 3,000 crores, that will increase our capacity to 1.3 million ton production.

triggers.label: Utilisation 80% → 88%
triggers.quote: in past we have been achieving a capacity utilization of almost 80%. But we have taken lot of initiatives and now we are at 88%.

triggers.label: Capacity 1.0 → 1.3 Mt on INR 3,000 cr capex
triggers.quote: that will increase our capacity to 1.3 million ton production

triggers.label: Revenue INR 5,300–5,400 cr target
triggers.quote: the overall revenue should go up to somewhere around INR 5,300 crores, INR 5,400 crores with that

triggers.label: EBITDA/ton INR 8,300 → 8,785
triggers.quote: improved meaningfully from INR 8,300 per ton in FY25 to INR 8,785 per ton in FY26

guidance.quote: the overall revenue should go up to somewhere around INR 5,300 crores, INR 5,400 crores with that
We expect this to translate into an EBITDA improvement of approximately INR 2,000 per ton
we expect somewhere around 90%, 92% will be a good level of capacity utilization
this should commence production sometime in H2 of this financial year
That is likely to be completed by FY28.
intend to present this opportunity in Q2 FY27

red_flags.label: INR 440 cr borrowings alongside INR 800 cr surplus; cash lent intercorporate at 12% payable on demand
red_flags.quote: we have deployed the money in the intercorporate market at an interest rate of 12%, and this amount is payable on demand within three months

red_flags.label: Inconsistent capex funding statements (internal accruals vs equity/external borrowing)
red_flags.quote: implementation of that project from a balanced funding proposal with equity and external borrowing

evasions.quote: No, in INR 3,000 crores program there is no equity program. It is all from internal generation.
Not right at this moment sir.
